title: The Kidnapped Woodsman
description: Tomas didn't come back from the eastern stands three nights running, and his axe mule came back without him. His wife knows what a woodsman missing that long usually means. She's asking a stranger to go look because the not-knowing has gotten worse than the knowing would be, and because there's nobody left to cut wood before winter if she waits on the guard.

objectives.description: Locate the bandit hideout that took Tomas, east of Thornfield

notes: Rescue kind 4 of 4: straight and grim. No twist - a man is taken, his wife asks a stranger because there's no one else to ask, and the stakes are plain: no woodsman, no winter wood. Giver motive stated directly in her own words. Consequence of refusal: the household loses its only earner before the cold sets in.
